name: Lamech
bio:
Lamech is the son of Methuselah and father of Noah. Scripture records little about him, but preserves one meaningful statement: he named his son "Noah," saying, "This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed" (Genesis 5:28-29).

This statement reveals Lamech's hope in God's promise — even in an age overshadowed by sin and the curse, he still expected that God would bring comfort through this child. Though Lamech himself never took part in Noah's later building of the ark or surviving the flood (he died five years before it came), the name and words he gave his son stand as a glimmer of hope for God's mercy and comfort before the coming judgment of the flood.
